text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out together…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way home, Mejiro Ryan stops and stares at a display window with eager eyes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ryan and her trainer! What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh! When did you get here, Ines?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You really didn't notice me? I swear…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I wonder what's caught your attention. Let's see, let's see…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oooh! That's a cute dress! It's kind of like a maid outfit.
choice_data_list: Got your eye on that dress?
Got your eye on that dress?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-no, not one bit! I didn't even notice it there!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But you were staring at it like you found a new gym or something.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait… Did you change your hair?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! You noticed?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well… since we had plans to go out today, I thought I'd style it a little differently.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahh, I get it now. You were just checking out your hair in the window.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I keep worrying that it won't stay together…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So I've been restless this whole time. I can't seem to relax at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wow… D-do I?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You really should've said so sooner!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Then Ryan wouldn't have been so self-conscious this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're her trainer! You need to pay more attention!
choice_data_list: I understand. I'll be more attentive from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: More attentive… That'd make me even more nervous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a new understanding of Ryan's efforts, we all head back to the academy together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! O-oh, no need to apologize! I only changed it up a tiny bit—barely enough to notice!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: In that case… next time you should go for a bigger, BOLDER change!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: How about wearing an outfit like the one in this window?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh?! S-something cute like that? No way! Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Really? I think it'd suit you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us continue our lively conversation as we make our way back to the academy.
